Is mah jharkhand sthapna divas ka pakhvara manaya ja raha hai. rajy ke 26 sal ke saphar men vikas aur badlav ki uplabdhiyan ginaee ja rahi hai, lekin isi vikas ki tasvir ke bich kuchh aise samuday bhi hain, jinki jindgi aaj bhi buniyadi suvidhaon ke lie sangharsh kar rahi hai.
